description:
Lightweight, Comfortable, and Ready for Everyday Rides.

The E11EVEN DRAGONFLY Step-Thru Electric Bike is built for effortless everyday mobility. Featuring a lightweight aluminum frame, a smooth 350W motor, and an easy-access step-thru design, DRAGONFLY is ideal for commuting, neighborhood rides, and weekend outings.

Powered by a 48V 10Ah battery with a range of up to 55 miles, it offers reliable performance while maintaining a comfortable and natural riding experience. Combined with front suspension, hydraulic disc brakes, and a Shimano® 7-speed drivetrain, DRAGONFLY delivers confidence and comfort wherever your day takes you.

Key Features

⚡ 350W Efficient Motor
Enjoy smooth pedal assistance with a top speed of 20 MPH, ideal for city streets, bike paths, and recreational riding.

🔋 Reliable 48V Battery
Ride up to 55 miles on a single charge, giving you the freedom to commute, explore, or run daily errands with confidence.

🚲 Comfortable Step-Thru Frame
The low-step aluminum frame allows for easy mounting and dismounting while promoting a relaxed, upright riding position.

🌿 Lightweight & Agile Design
Equipped with 27.5" × 2.1 tires, DRAGONFLY offers responsive handling and a smooth ride on paved roads and bike paths.

🛡️ Safe & Comfortable Riding
A 60mm suspension fork absorbs road vibrations, while hydraulic disc brakes provide reliable stopping power in a variety of riding conditions.

⚙️ Shimano® 7-Speed Drivetrain
Shift smoothly with the Shimano® 7-speed gear system and SL-TX50-7R shifter for better control across different terrains.
